summary: Lipocine Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the presentation of Phase 3 clinical data for LPCN 1154 (oral brexanolone) at the ASCP Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results for postpartum depression, involving no transaction, corporate action, or special situation. There are no deal terms, stakeholder changes, or strategic events. The filing simply reports scientific data and exhibits. Thus it is not a special situation.
